s.n: Scott's book signing coffee and cookies
s.note: Scott enjoying free coffee and fame in San Francisco
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and an egg. Mix in 225g flour and 150g dark chocolate chips. Roll into balls and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Serve warm with small cups of freshly brewed coffee at the signing table.

s.note: the strange creatures of the quantum realm
s.how: Halve 2 bunches of broccolini, purple carrots and radishes and toss with oil, honey and chilli flakes. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes until charred at the edges. Blend herbs into Greek yoghurt for a green dip and serve the strange colours on a dark plate.

m.note: Lord Krylar's restaurant in the quantum realm
m.how: Simmer 300g black rice in 400ml coconut milk and water for 35 minutes until tender. Grill 800g chicken thighs and slice. Quickly pickle shredded carrot and red cabbage in rice vinegar with sugar. Serve the chicken on the purple rice with the pickles.

w.note: everything shrinking and growing in the quantum realm
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake half as mini cupcakes for 12 minutes and half as one giant cupcake for 40 minutes at 175C. Ice all of them with red buttercream made with icing sugar.

d.how: Steep 2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 500ml boiling water for 5 minutes, strain and chill until deep blue. Fill 4 glasses with ice and 150ml lemonade each, then pour the blue tea over and watch it swirl purple. Add a squeeze of lemon.
